description: This Java class 'FlexibleMapAccessor' provides flexible access to Map values, supporting nested expressions, dot notation, and list indexing. It includes methods for retrieving, setting, and removing values from maps, with support for localization and expression evaluation.

classes.name: FlexibleMapAccessor
classes.description: A utility class for flexible access to Map entries, supporting nested expressions, list indexing, and localization.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to retrieve a singleton instance of FlexibleMapAccessor for a given expression string.

methods.name: containsNestedExpression
methods.description: Checks if the accessor contains a nested expression.

methods.name: getOriginalName
methods.description: Returns the original expression string used to create the accessor.

methods.name: getIsAscending
methods.description: Indicates if the accessor is set to ascending order.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the accessor is empty.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the map based on the expression, with optional locale support.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Sets a value in the map based on the expression.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a value from the map based on the expression.

methods.name: getExpression
methods.description: Constructs the expression string used for evaluation based on the internal state.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the original expression string.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on the original expression string.
